entities.summary: Maria Mezentseva is a Ukrainian politician. Mezentseva was elected to Verkhovna Rada, the Ukrainian parliament, in 2019. She holds several positions related to European integration, including deputy chairperson of the Committee on Ukraine's Integration into the European Union and chairperson of the Ukrainian delegation to the Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe.
